item.title: BREAKING: Boko Haram Attacks Military Base In Borno, Kills Army General, Several Other Soldiers, Brigade Islamic Cleric
item.description: BREAKING: Boko Haram Attacks Military Base In Borno, Kills Army General, Several Other Soldiers, Brigade Islamic Cleric Military sources told SaharaReporters that the attack occurred on Wednesday night when the insurgents launched an assault on the Joint Task Force in Benesheikh, Kaga Local Government Area.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Late Brig.-Gen. Braimoh Tried To Escape Boko Haram Assault But Armoured Vehicle Failed To Start –Military Sources
item.description: EXCLUSIVE: Late Brig.-Gen. Braimoh Tried To Escape Boko Haram Assault But Armoured Vehicle Failed To Start –Military Sources Military sources who spoke to SaharaReporters on Thursday alleged that the late commander attempted to escape the attack scene but was unable to do so due to a faulty armoured vehicle.

item.title: BREAKING: Court Halts Controversial N36Billion Construction On Disputed FGC Kano Land, Orders Status Quo
item.description: BREAKING: Court Halts Controversial N36Billion Construction On Disputed FGC Kano Land, Orders Status Quo The order, delivered by Hon. Justice Yusuf Ubale Muhammad followed an ex parte motion filed by the Incorporated Trustees of the Federal Government College (FGC) Kano Old Students Association against multiple defendants, including the Minister of Education, Ministry of Land and Physical Planning Kano State, Kano State Urban Development Authority, and Pluck Global Company Ltd.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Lebanese-Nigerian Businessman Nidal Karameh, Mikano And Orca Mall Owner, Linked To Greek Island Drug Seizure
item.description: EXCLUSIVE: Lebanese-Nigerian Businessman Nidal Karameh, Mikano And Orca Mall Owner, Linked To Greek Island Drug Seizure Sources, including Global Fraud Watch, claim that a luxury yacht identified as “Hallo,” allegedly linked to Karameh, was raided by Greek police during an anti-narcotics operation on the island.

item.title: BREAKING: Tinubu Gov't Moves To Frustrate ADC National Convention, Withholds Approval For Eagle Square, Velodrome
item.description: BREAKING: Tinubu Gov't Moves To Frustrate ADC National Convention, Withholds Approval For Eagle Square, Velodrome The ADC spokesperson, Bolaji Abdullahi, disclosed this in an exclusive interview with SaharaReporters on Friday, revealing that the party’s request to use the Eagle Square has been ignored, while an alternative venue, the Velodrome, was also declined.

item.title: Boko Haram Releases Disturbing Video Of 416 Abducted Women, Children In Borno As Victims Beg Tinubu, Others For Help
item.description: Boko Haram Releases Disturbing Video Of 416 Abducted Women, Children In Borno As Victims Beg Tinubu, Others For Help The captives, mostly women and children, are seen pleading with the Nigerian government to meet the insurgents’ demands in order to secure their release.

item.title: DSS Arrests Ex-Lawmaker Aliyu Gebi For Allegedly Supplying False Intelligence To Foreign Embassies
item.description: DSS Arrests Ex-Lawmaker Aliyu Gebi For Allegedly Supplying False Intelligence To Foreign Embassies Gebi, a politician and security consultant who served in the 7th National Assembly, was arrested on Friday, April 3, according to security sources familiar with the development.

item.title: EFCC Spent N54Million To Sponsor Five Judges For London Symposium
item.description: EFCC Spent N54Million To Sponsor Five Judges For London Symposium The payment, made on August 27, 2025, was issued to Wakanow.com Limited, according to records on the public expenditure portal, Govspend.

item.title: BREAKING: Nigerian Commission INEC Postpones Nationwide Voters Revalidation Till After 2027 elections
item.description: BREAKING: Nigerian Commission INEC Postpones Nationwide Voters Revalidation Till After 2027 elections In a statement on Friday, Mohammed Haruna, INEC’s national commissioner and chairman of information and voter education committee, said the decision was made at a meeting between the commission and resident electoral commissioners (RECs).

item.title: BREAKING: At Least 1100 Nigerians Abducted Since January Under Tinubu Govt – Amnesty Int'l Demands Urgent Action
item.description: BREAKING: At Least 1100 Nigerians Abducted Since January Under Tinubu Govt – Amnesty Int'l Demands Urgent Action In a press release issued on Saturday ,11 April 2026, the organisation said President Bola Tinubu and his government must urgently respond to the “horrifying spate of abductions targeting rural communities and internally displaced persons (IDP) in the northern part of the country.”

item.title: Nigerian Government Sanctions Tukur Mamu, Simon Ekpa, 46 Others Over Alleged Terrorism Links
item.description: Nigerian Government Sanctions Tukur Mamu, Simon Ekpa, 46 Others Over Alleged Terrorism Links Also on the list is Simon Ekpa, a former self-proclaimed prime minister of the Indigenous People of Biafra (IPOB) who was tried in Finland.

item.title: FULL LIST: Nigeria Names Tukur Mamu, Simon Njoku, IPOB Among 48 Individuals, 12 Entities In Fresh Terror-Financing List
item.description: FULL LIST: Nigeria Names Tukur Mamu, Simon Njoku, IPOB Among 48 Individuals, 12 Entities In Fresh Terror-Financing List The list, published on the website of the Nigeria Sanctions Committee (NIGSAC), disclosed the nationalities of those named, their specific roles, and the terrorist groups they were allegedly connected to.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: DSS Masks Bauchi Man In Front Of His Children, Arrests Him Day Before Daughter's Wedding, Family Says No Reason Given
item.description: EXCLUSIVE: DSS Masks Bauchi Man In Front Of His Children, Arrests Him Day Before Daughter's Wedding, Family Says No Reason Given Family members said the timing of the arrest and DSS’s failure to disclose the reason for Wanka’s arrest and detention made the situation even more painful, as they had been preparing for what was meant to be a joyous celebration.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Nigerian Policemen Fighting Lakurawa Terrorists In Kwara Lament Hunger, Threaten To Abandon Posts Over Unpaid Allowances
item.description: EXCLUSIVE: Nigerian Policemen Fighting Lakurawa Terrorists In Kwara Lament Hunger, Threaten To Abandon Posts Over Unpaid Allowances The officers, drawn from various states and assigned to joint security operations alongside other security agencies, said they were deployed to combat Lakurawa terrorists operating in the region.

item.title: Nigerian Military Jet Strikes Crowded Weekly Market On Borno-Yobe Border, At Least 56 Dead –Eyewitnesses, Officials
item.description: Nigerian Military Jet Strikes Crowded Weekly Market On Borno-Yobe Border, At Least 56 Dead –Eyewitnesses, Officials The strike was believed to have been carried out during a military operation targeting suspected Boko Haram insurgents, although multiple sources indicated that the intended targets were missed.
